description: Two-panel composite figure of machine-learning prediction results for yield strength (YS); both panels are generic data plots (no micrograph, spectrum or schematic). (a) "Actual vs Predicted Values" is a scatter plot: x-axis "Actual YS/MPa", y-axis "Predicted YS/MPa", both spanning 0-3000 with ticks every 500 MPa, plus a red dashed 1:1 reference line. Blue circular markers lie nearly on the diagonal, densely clustered between roughly 100 and 2000 MPa; only a few points near 2600-2900 MPa appear, and these sit slightly below the line (under-predicted). (b) "Evolution Progress" is a genetic-algorithm convergence plot: x-axis "Generation" 0-30 (ticks every 5), y-axis "RMSE" from 0 to above 500000 with ticks at 100000 intervals. The legend lists "Best RMSE" (blue solid line with circle markers), which is flat at essentially zero for all generations, and "Average RMSE" (green dashed line with square markers), which drops steeply from ~540000 at generation 0, then fluctuates roughly between 20000 and 240000, touches near zero around generation 20, and shows late upward spikes near generations 24-27. The panels jointly argue that the GA-optimized Extra trees model predicts YS almost exactly on the 1:1 line while the GA population error converges to the best individual.
measured_quantities: RMSE (as plotted, unitless on axis; reported as MPa in text)

observations.observation: Panel (a) axes are 'Actual YS/MPa' (x) and 'Predicted YS/MPa' (y), each ranging 0-3000 MPa with gridline ticks every 500 MPa, and a red dashed 1:1 reference line is drawn.
In panel (a), blue circular markers cluster tightly on the red dashed line between about 100 and 2000 MPa, while the few points near 2600-2900 MPa lie slightly below the line.
Panel (b) plots 'RMSE' (y, 0 to above 500000, ticks every 100000) against 'Generation' (x, 0-30, ticks every 5).
Panel (b) legend contains two series: 'Best RMSE' (blue solid line, circle markers) and 'Average RMSE' (green dashed line, square markers).

The 'Best RMSE' series in panel (b) is essentially flat at zero for every generation shown, whereas 'Average RMSE' begins near 540000 at generation 0 and only converges to the best value late in the run.
'Average RMSE' in panel (b) fluctuates strongly between about 20000 and 240000, reaches its lowest values around generation 20, and shows renewed spikes near generations 24-27 before dropping again.
The caption states that following GA optimization the GA-Extra trees model achieved an RMSE value of 31.60 MPa.
The citing text states the GA-Extra trees model reduced RMSE by 44.60 MPa relative to the standard Extra trees model.
The citing text states the MAPE value was 4.39 %, a decrease of 5.41 % relative to the standard Extra trees model.
The citing text states the R value reached 0.997, an improvement of 0.019 over the pre-optimization state.

The y-axis of panel (b) carries no unit label and its printed magnitudes (~10^5) cannot be reconciled with the 31.60 MPa RMSE stated in the text; the panel is therefore on a different (apparently unscaled) error scale than the reported metric.
Neither panel prints numeric data labels, RMSE/MAPE/R values or a sample size; all quantitative anchors (31.60 MPa, 4.39 %, 0.997) come from the caption and citing text, not from pixels.
